subject: Service identities, SCIM fields and IP allowlist — onboarding plan
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@paradoxai.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kai Tanaka <kai@paradoxai.com>
Date: Tue, 01 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: SSO/SCIM questions + IP ranges

Hi Olga —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re ready to start the onboarding workstream but have a few early technical questions to make sure we sequence correctly:

- We’ll be provisioning users from Paradox’s Okta org via SCIM. Can you confirm which SCIM attributes you require (firstName/lastName/email + custom role mapping)?
- We need guidance on the service account(s) Redwood expects for provisioning and API calls — should they be long-lived keys or short-lived tokens?
- Our security team requires explicit IP allowlist ranges for staging and prod so they can open firewall rules before cutover. Do you have a recommended CIDR set we can give them?

We’re aiming for an initial staging cutover on 2028-05-15; if there are any blockers (SCIM mapping, service identity creation, or org policies) we want to surface them now.

Attach: sample SAML metadata from our IdP (sent separately).

Thanks,
Anna Lopez
Head of IT Ops, ParadoxAI
anna.lopez@paradoxai.com
+1 415 555 0123
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@paradoxai.com>, Kai Tanaka <kai@paradoxai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: SSO/SCIM questions + IP ranges

Hi Anna — great to hear you’re ready. Below is a concise plan and the immediate asks so we don’t run into last-minute firewall or provisioning gaps. I’ve attached a short checklist and a SCIM attribute CSV template.

Quick plan (staging cutover target 2028-05-15):
1) Today — confirm SCIM attributes + service account pattern.
2) 05/03 — Redwood creates service identity and shares bootstrap credentials in the customer vault (short-lived tokens preferred).
3) 05/06 — Paradox teams test SCIM provisioning into staging (create/update/delete).
4) 05/10 — IP allowlist applied by Paradox Security; dry-run traffic allowed from Redwood staging pool.
5) 05/15 — Staging cutover; smoke tests; rollback window until 05/17.

Immediate answers:
- SCIM attributes: required = userName, name.givenName, name.familyName, emails[0].value. We also accept groups for role mapping; for fine-grained roles include groups and an optional 'appRole' custom extension (see attached CSV).
- Service identities: we recommend creating one service account per environment (redwood-provisioning-staging, redwood-provisioning-prod). We will issue short-lived bearer tokens via the vault; those tokens auto-rotate and are what our SCIM connector will use. Long-lived API keys are discouraged for provisioning.
- IP allowlist: for staging we’ll use 34.210.128.0/20 and 54.173.32.0/21; for prod we’ll use 18.197.64.0/20 and 54.213.0.0/19. These are the minimal CIDRs we need opened; if your security policy requires static host IPs we can provide the NAT IPs per-region.

Next asks for your team (please reply inline):
- Confirm whether Paradox will send group->role mappings or if you want Redwood to map via the 'appRole' SCIM extension.
- Provide the target Okta SCIM base URL and any test org credentials we can use in staging (these are consumed only by our connector).

Attachments: paradox_sso_scim_checklist.pdf, scim-attribute-mapping.csv, ip-allowlist-template.txt

I’ll loop in Ben for cutover coordination and Jonas for implementation validation.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Technical Program Manager — Customer Success
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 02 May 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: SSO/SCIM questions + IP ranges

Adding a couple of operational notes to make the cutover less risky:

- Service account provisioning: we’ll create the two env-specific identities tomorrow and post bootstrap info to the Paradox vault entry in our secure share (will include a one-time setup token and rotation schedule).
- SCIM acceptance tests: Jonas, can you add the following tests to the runbook — create user, update email, add group, remove group, deprovision and verify immediate removal within 30s? We need deterministic behavior for the security team.
- Org policy considerations: Paradox mentioned they have strict device restrictions. Neha, please confirm whether we need to enforce an additional login restriction on the Redwood side for device posture at cutover, or whether their IdP will handle it.

Ben
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 03 May 2028 10:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: SSO/SCIM questions + IP ranges

Thanks — I’ve updated the staging runbook with the acceptance tests Ben listed and added a checklist item to validate SCIM attribute transformations for multi-valued emails and group->role mapping. A couple things from the engineering side:

- SCIM custom extension: if Paradox prefers to send 'appRole' we’ll map that to our internal RBAC during provisioning. If not, we’ll accept groups and default-map based on group name prefixes (paradox-admins -> admin, paradox-analytics -> viewer).
- Service account auth: we’ll use short-lived tokens from Redwood Vault; recommend Paradox allowlist the token-issuing IPs (same CIDRs as stated).
- Telemetry: during the 05/15 cutover we’ll enable verbose SCIM logs (retained for 72 hours) and tag those requests with 'paradox-onboard' for quick traceability.

I’ll run a quick staging dry-run on 05/06 and share logs.

—Jonas
Principal Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@paradoxai.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kai Tanaka <kai@paradoxai.com>, Bridget O'Neill <bridget.oneill@paradoxai.com>
Date: Thu, 04 May 2028 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: SSO/SCIM questions + IP ranges

Appreciate the clear plan — confirming the following from our side:

- We will send group->role mappings using the 'appRole' custom attribute (Okta can include that in the SCIM payload).
- Provisioning test creds for staging: okta-paradox-staging-scim (we’ll email secure credentials to the vault entry you provide).
- IP allowlist: security approved opening the staging CIDRs you listed; procurement is working on prod approvals and I’ll share the contact (Bridget) for any contracted SLA discussion.

One ask before you create the service identities: can you include the token TTL and rotation cadence in the vault entry so we can align with our rotation policy?

Thanks — we’ll aim for the 05/06 test and confirm once the staging creds are loaded.

Anna

I’ll update the runbook with the exact vault key names and notify Paradox when complete.

Thanks,
Olga
